packageRules.description: VuePress core + bundler + theme + plugins must move together (peer deps)

Blocked: vuepress-theme-hope@2.0.0-rc.110 peer-pins vuepress exactly 2.0.0-rc.31 and its plugin line (rc.137 search-helper) breaks the docs build (ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION on search-helper dist .css during SSR). Remove these pins when theme-hope releases a version built for core rc.32+ and search-helper is fixed upstream.

Blocked: @vuepress/search-helper rc.137+ (pulled in by plugin-slimsearch >= rc.137) fails the docs build with ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION for its dist .css import during SSR rendering. Stay on rc.134 until upstream fixes search-helper.
plugin-llms rc.138 peer-pins vuepress 2.0.0-rc.32, which is still blocked by the theme pin above.
Block v10: breaks @semantic-release/release-notes-generator notes generation (semantic-release/release-notes-generator#992) until semantic-release supports the new preset interface

matchStrings:
procedure (?<procedureName>Dependency_AddDotNet\d+(?:Asp|Desktop)?);?
begin?
  // https://dotnet\.microsoft\.com/download/dotnet/(?<packageName>\d+\.\d+)?
  if not Dependency_IsNetCoreInstalled\('(?<runtimeName>[^']+)', \d+, \d+, \d+\) then begin?
    Dependency_Add\('(?<archiveName>[^']+)' \+ Dependency_ArchSuffix \+ '\.exe',?
      '/lcid ' \+ IntToStr\(GetUILanguage\) \+ ' /passive /norestart',?
      '(?<displayNamePrefix>[^']+? )(?<currentValue>\d+\.\d+\.\d+)' \+ Dependency_ArchTitle,?
      Dependency_String\('https://builds\.dotnet\.microsoft\.com/dotnet/(?<downloadPath>[^']+?)/\d+\.\d+\.\d+/(?<binaryNamePrefix>[^']+?)-\d+\.\d+\.\d+-win-x86\.exe', 'https://builds\.dotnet\.microsoft\.com/dotnet/[^']+?/\d+\.\d+\.\d+/[^']+?-\d+\.\d+\.\d+-win-x64\.exe', 'https://builds\.dotnet\.microsoft\.com/dotnet/[^']+?/\d+\.\d+\.\d+/[^']+?-\d+\.\d+\.\d+-win-arm64\.exe'\),?
      '', False, False\);?
  end;?
end;
